documented: Listing object includes is_verified but says nothing about is_live.
actual: Listing object includes an undocumented is_live boolean.
impact: Critical for accurate active listing count

documented: Returns active sale listings. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
actual: Returns both active and inactive listings. is_live can be false.
how_found: Counted records with is_live: false in the full snapshot.
impact: Frontend must manually filter is_live === true to avoid showing dead properties.

documented: Area: Square feet, integer, everywhere in the API
actual: Some listings have carpet_area in square meters (resulting in >60,000 INR/sqft, which is wildly outside Gurgaon norms).
how_found: Computed price/sqft distribution and flagged outliers > 60k.
impact: Must detect and convert sqm to sqft for those specific listings to compute accurate averages.

documented: total_listings is recomputed... it always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns
actual: total_listings on the project object frequently disagrees with the actual count of live listings for that project.
how_found: Grouped snapshot by project_id and compared counts against project.total_listings.
impact: Frontend must recompute total_listings from raw listings to be accurate.

documented: Every page of results tells you truthfully... (implied structural validity)
actual: A small subset of listings contain structural impossibilities (e.g., carpet_area > super_built_up_area, floor > total_floors, coords outside NCR).
how_found: Scanned all records for physical impossibilities.
impact: These listings must be flagged or excluded from analysis.
